_comment: The backlog tools/dolibarr/sync-pm.sh rolls into the ERP. Copy this file to
pm-spec.json, which is gitignored because the real backlog names people and
links private documents, and these repositories are going public.
A project is matched by its exact title and a task by its exact label, so
renaming either creates a second record rather than renaming the first one.
Only the fields an entry names are written; everything else on the record is
left as the UI has it. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Nothing is ever deleted.
